question: Does Volcengine AgentKit grant a new-account trial pack for sandbox time, and what does signup require (real-name verification, phone, card)?
why: The rendered first-party billing page lists per-second sandbox prices and a free shared-gateway count only. Third-party articles on volcengine.com describe a 30-day trial of 10 sandbox hours or 100 hours with real-name verification, but they contradict each other and no first-party page states it; the account signup docs render empty through the broker.
